description: This file defines the AOD_Index class for managing a deprecated search index feature in SuiteCRM, extending AOD_Index_sugar and using Zend Lucene for full-text search operations, including indexing, searching, and optimization.

classes.name: AOD_Index
classes.description: A deprecated class for managing full-text search indexing using Zend Lucene in SuiteCRM; includes methods for indexing, searching, retrieving documents, and configuration, marked as deprecated since version 7.12.0.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing language encoding and analysis settings for Lucene.

isEnabled.name: isEnabled
isEnabled.description: Checks if the search index feature is enabled in the global configuration.

find.name: find
find.description: Performs a search on the Lucene index with a provided query string.

optimise.name: optimise
optimise.description: Optimizes the Lucene index if the feature is enabled.

getIndex.name: getIndex
getIndex.description: Retrieves or creates the singleton index bean.

getDocumentForRevision.name: getDocumentForRevision
getDocumentForRevision.description: Creates a Lucene document from a file revision, supporting multiple mime types.

getDocumentForBean.name: getDocumentForBean
getDocumentForBean.description: Generates a Lucene document for a given SugarBean, adding fields based on its properties.

getBoost.name: getBoost
getBoost.description: Calculates a boost value for a field based on module and field name.

getIndexEvent.name: getIndexEvent
getIndexEvent.description: Retrieves or creates an index event record associated with a specific bean and module.

commit.name: commit
commit.description: Commits changes to the Lucene index if the feature is enabled.

isModuleSearchable.name: isModuleSearchable
isModuleSearchable.description: Checks if a specific module and bean are configured to be searchable.

index.name: index
index.description: Indexes a specific bean in a module, updating the index and related events.

getIdForDoc.name: getIdForDoc
getIdForDoc.description: Constructs a unique ID string for a document based on module and bean ID.

remove.name: remove
remove.description: Removes a bean's document from the Lucene index.

getLuceneIndex.name: getLuceneIndex
getLuceneIndex.description: Provides access to the Lucene index instance, creating it if necessary.

getIndexableModules.name: getIndexableModules
getIndexableModules.description: Returns a list of modules that are configured to be indexed for search.
